scattered.t9: Quick! Where do all your best insights and musings live? Scattered across presentations, conversations, articles, notes, AI chats, and half-finished drafts, right?
scattered.t10: Some haven’t even gotten out of your head yet.
scattered.t11: Meanwhile, the pressure to do something with all of that doesn’t let up. You try to publish it, only to watch it disappear into the feed within hours.

what_if.t3: What if, instead of constantly creating vanishing content — or nothing at all — you could have an asset that establishes what you know, what you stand for, and why people should seek you out?
what_if.t4: (Without having to disappear for six months to a cabin in the woods.)
what_if.t5: That's what a signature Authority Asset does. It's a substantial piece of work that captures your best thinking and gives you something to draw from for years.
